summary.text: Gail Davenport, a Democrat, represents Georgia Senate District 17, which includes portions of Clayton and Henry counties.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Davenport is a real estate professional with Keller Williams Realty Atlanta Classic who has worked in the real estate industry for three decades.

Davenport established the Henry and Clara Dixon Education Fund in 1997 and founded COLLEGE BOUND, a residential summer program for high school students, and was a delegate to the Democratic National Convention in 2004, 2008 and 2012.
